card_description:
**Priority:** P0 | **Location:** San Francisco / Singapore (Global) | **AUM:** $500M

**Investment Thesis:**
Gaming and interactive entertainment focused; investments across game studios, infrastructure, and emerging platforms. Strong Asia-US bridge with Singapore HQ. Seed to Series A stage with $5M-$40M check sizes.

**Why They're a Good Target:**
- Just led BIT ODD (€17M Seed, Nov 2024) and Human Computer ($5.7M, Mar 2025) - extremely active in Q4 2024/Q1 2025
- Jay Chi has unmatched gaming strategy credentials: 11.5 years at McKinsey leading global video games practice, ex-Tencent
- $500M Fund III (2022) with global reach - can write larger checks and follow-on
- Singapore HQ provides Asia market access and APAC gaming ecosystem connectivity
- Infrastructure/tools thesis demonstrated via recent investments

**Key Partners:**

| Name | Title | Background | Priority |
|------|-------|------------|----------|
| Jay Chi | Founding Partner | Ex-McKinsey (11.5 yrs, global video games practice lead), ex-Tencent | PRIMARY |
| Michael Cheung | Partner | Gaming ops background, Asia gaming specialist | SECONDARY |
| Alli Ottarsson | Investment | Gaming industry veteran | TERTIARY |

**Portfolio Companies (Recent):**
- BIT ODD (€17M Seed, Nov 2024) - Swedish game studio (ex-Avalanche/DICE founders)
- Human Computer ($5.7M, Mar 2025) - AI + gaming infrastructure
- Second Studio (2024) - Game development

**Warm Path Opportunities:**
- Tencent connection via Jay Chi's background (if Tencent alum in network)
- McKinsey network (if consulting background)
- BIT ODD founders: ex-Avalanche Studios/DICE (if network overlap)
- Singapore gaming ecosystem connections

**Recommended Outreach Angle:**
**Subject:** [Game Infrastructure/AI] Seed - Scaling Games Globally

**Hook:** Lead with global scaling angle - Jay's McKinsey/Tencent background means he thinks about international markets and platform strategy. Reference BIT ODD or Human Computer investments as market validation. Emphasize APAC angle if relevant (Singapore HQ).

**Key Talking Points:**
1. Global gaming infrastructure opportunity (US + APAC markets)
2. Technical differentiation in crowded gaming tools market
3. Clear monetization/path to Series A (Jay likes metrics)
4. Asia market expansion strategy (if applicable)
5. Platform-layer investment thesis alignment

**Contact Information:**
- Jay Chi: jay@makersfund.com | LinkedIn: /in/jaysonchi
- Website: https://www.makersfund.com
- Fund: $500M Fund III, actively deploying

**Research Sources:**
- https://www.makersfund.com/team
- https://signal.nfx.com/investors/jay-chi
- TechCrunch: Makers Fund closes $500M Fund III (2022)
- LinkedIn: Jay Chi active poster on gaming investments

**Next Action:** Send cold email to Jay Chi emphasizing global gaming infrastructure thesis and BIT ODD/Human Computer investment thesis alignment.
checklist: Check LinkedIn for mutual connections to Jay Chi (McKinsey/Tencent)
Draft personalized outreach referencing BIT ODD/Human Computer
Send cold email with global gaming infrastructure angle
Follow up if no response in 5 days (very active investor)
